bounciness.description: The amount of velocity to be kept when this particle collides with something. Directional velocity is multipled by (-Bounciness * 0.65) on any collision.

colorByBlock.description: Whether or not to color the particle by the block it's on.

deathParticles.description: More particles that spawn when this particle dies.

dieInAir.description: Whether or not the particle dies in air

dieInLiquid.description: Whether or not the particle dies in water

dieOnRainHeightmap.description: If true, particle dies if it falls below the rain height at its given location

gravityEffect.description: The gravity effect on the particle

hsvaColor.description: The Hue/Saturation/Value/Alpha for the color of the particle.

lifeLength.description: The life length, in seconds, of the particle

particleModel.description: Sets the base model for the particle.

posOffset.description: Offset from the blocks hitboxes top middle position

quantity.description: The quantity of the particles given.

randomVelocityChange.description: Allows each particle to randomly change its velocity over time.

secondaryParticles.description: More particles that spawn from this particle over time. See SecondarySpawnInterval to control rate

secondarySpawnInterval.description: The interval that the SecondaryParticles spawn

selfPropelled.description: Whether or not the particle is self propelled

size.description: The size of the particles given.

swimOnLiquid.description: Whether or not the particle floats on liquids.

terrainCollision.description: Whether or not the particle collides with the terrain

vertexFlags.description: The level of glow in the particle

windAffectednes.description: How much the particles are affected by wind.
